WELCOME TO
CHEMICAL, ENVIRONMENTAL,
AND MATERIALS ENGINEERING
The Department of Chemical, Environmental, and Materials Engineering provides high-quality undergraduate and graduate education in chemical, environmental, and materials engineering that prepares graduates for professional careers and a lifetime of learning; to conduct high-quality research that will advance the current body of knowledge and engage in new discoveries to improve the quality of human life; and to serve the engineering profession and society through active involvement in professional organizations and contribution of professional expertise.

Our Mission
The mission of the CEME Department is to advance and impart knowledge that addresses global challenges related to the fields of chemical, environmental, and materials engineering. The Department aims to create an inclusive environment that educates the next generation of engineers who promote sustainability through the development of novel chemical processes, environmental systems, and innovative materials that improve the quality of life in both the built and natural environment.
